title: Light Microscopy of Secretory Spines
author: Mario A. Sandoval-Molina
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kzrcx56
materials: Areole tissue was removed from the cladode and sectioned transversely to expose the secretory spine on longitudinal plane. Tissue was fixed on FAA solution for 72 h. FAA fixative solution: 10 mL of formalin, formaldehyde 37 % in H2O , contains 10-15% methanol as stabilizer to prevent polymerization (Sigma-Aldrich F16-35). 5 mL glacial acetic acid, ACS reagent, ≥99.7% (Sigma-Aldrich 695092) 50% ethanol 96% (Sigma-Aldrich E1860100) 25 mL double distilled water. After 72 h tissue was washed three times (15 min) in deionised water.

Fixed tissue was dehydrated in ethanol solutions (50%, 70%, 80%, 96%, 100%, 100%) for 2 h. in each concentration. Then the tissue was infiltrated in 3:1, 1:1, 1:3 (ethanol : xilene) and xilene (two changes) for 4 h each, then to Paraplast plus (McCormick Scientific, Supplier: Leica Biosystems) two changes for 12h. Tissue was embedded in Paraplast, and considering the EFNs as a unit. We obtained 8 µm-thick longitudinal sections in the central area of the EFNs spine in each sample with a rotatory microtome (American Optical Company, USA).

steps.title: Mount and Dry Sections
steps.instruction: Mount paraffin sections on glass slides using chromium gelatine adhesive.

substeps.instruction: Prepare adhesive consisting of 1% gelatine, 0.1% phenol, and 0.05% chrome alum (Cr K (SO4)2 · 12 (H2O) in water).
Place slides on a hot plate at 60 °C for 12 h.

steps.title: Dewax and Hydrate Sections
steps.instruction: Remove paraffin and hydrate the sections through a series of solvents.

substeps.instruction: Dewax in 100% xylene: three changes for 3 min each.
Hydrate in a serial of ethanol (100%, 96%, 70%, and 50%) for 3 min each.

steps.title: Perform Safranin Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the sections with safranin and wash.

substeps.instruction: Stain with 0.5% safranin (Safranin O (C.I. 50240) for microscopy, Merck) in a saline solution (3% NaCl in water) for 2 h.
Wash twice in deionised water for 3 min each.

steps.title: Dehydrate and Counterstain
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the sections and apply fast green FCF stain.

substeps.instruction: Dehydrate in an ethanol series (50%, 70%, 90%, 100%) for 2 min each.
Stain in 0.12% fast green FCF (C.I. 42053 for Microscopy, Merck) in 95% ethanol for 1 min.
Mount sections in Eukit mounting medium.
Dry on a hot plate at 60 °C.

steps.title: Observe and Capture Images
steps.instruction: Perform light microscopy and image acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Observe sections using an Axiostar Plus light microscope (Carl Zeiss, Germany).
Capture images with an Axiocam MRc5 (Carl Zeiss, Germany).
